title: Longitudinal Controller Stanley
text: Control longitudinal velocity of vehicle by using Stanley method, 4 inputs, 2 outputs; {Proportional gain, Kp}, {Integral gain, Ki}, {Sample time (s)}, {Maximum longitudinal acceleration (m/s^2)} and {Maximum longitudinal deceleration (m/s^2)}. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Reset
ports.summary: Trigger to reset integral of velocity error 0 (hold steady) | nonzero scalar (reset)

ports.name: AccelCmd
ports.summary: Acceleration command real scalar in the range [0, M A ]

ports.name: DecelCmd
ports.summary: Deceleration command real scalar in the range [0, M D ]

params.name: Maximum longitudinal acceleration (m/s^2)
params.values: Maximum longitudinal acceleration 3 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Maximum longitudinal deceleration (m/s^2)
params.values: Maximum longitudinal deceleration 6 (default) | positive real scalar
